notes.title: My Trainer is a Futanari ANNOUNCED!
notes.content:
Introducing My Trainer is a Futanari:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1950460/My_Trainer_is_a_Futanari/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1950460/My_Trainer_is_a_Futanari/[/url]

Wishlist Now! 😏

"New year, new me!"

You decided to make the commitment of signing up for a full membership at your local gym.
You went the extra mile and got a personal trainer to help you along and hold you accountable.
Kendra comes highly recommended and with her abs of steel, she's often touted as: "THE REAL DEAL".

Get ready for the workout of a lifetime!

notes.title: My Pet Sitter is a Futanari AVAILABLE NOW!
notes.content:
Get it on Steam NOW:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1854810/My_Pet_Sitter_is_a_Futanari]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1854810/My_Pet_Sitter_is_a_Futanari[/url]

Complaints from the neighbors has forced you to get a Pet Sitter to look after your dog while you're out for long periods of time.
The Pet Sitter is practically a dog whisperer and knows everything there is to know about the psychology of the canine variety.
She adores your four-legged friend and also seems to have taken a liking to you.

Can your Pet Sitter teach an old dog new tricks?

notes.title: My Therapist is a Futanari Out Now!
notes.content:
It feels like your life isn't going anywhere--like there's some kind of mental block standing in your way.
You take the first step towards making an improvement and set up an appointment with a therapist in your local area.

After putting it all out there in a "safe environment", you soon find yourself engaged in some very unconventional therapy.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1831260/My_Therapist_is_a_Futanari/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1831260/My_Therapist_is_a_Futanari/[/url]

notes.title: My Stepsis is a Futanari Out Now!
notes.content:
Had enough of Stepmom for now?
Perhaps it's time to spend some quality time with Stepsis then?

Well...

Your stepsis hates your guts and has rule over the house while your dad and stepmom are out of town for the weekend. What's more, her girlfriend is sleeping over, so shut-eye seems highly unlikely as usual. How will you ever cope?
